pr_title: ResourceLoader: Print load message only when actually loading
pr_body:
Not tested.

Note others may prefer the old behavior where the message corresponds to the resource being _requested to be loaded_ rather than _actually being loaded_. However, that's only theoretical. We know at least some prefer the way this PR introduces.

Fixes #99535.

issue_context.title: Godot4.4-dev4: Spaming loading messages if --verbose enabled.
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

- v4.4.dev4.mono.official [36e6207bb]
- v4.4.dev5.mono.official [9e6098432]

### System information

all

### Issue description


If verbose enabled, resource loading is now spamming loading messages.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e979ae8-81eb-40cd-afda-ca1f0a72fee9)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6b5661e-d645-4323-9da9-db6a9be15622)

I use `ResourceLoader.load(<script_name>, "GDScript", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REUSE)` to preload and force reuse scripts to mimimize loading times in my test framework. So I use explicit `CACHE_MODE_REUSE`.
But from the new log messages looks like the script is load again and again.

This spamming messages is filling my console when running my CI workflows now.
Godot4.4-dev5
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0464ed42-e92d-40f7-b386-693539018b5b)
Godot4.3-stable
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d125766c-ce23-4ad4-8012-98f8b34d71e2)




### Steps to reproduce

Use the script and attach it to a scene to reproduce.
```gd
extends Node2D


func _ready() -> void:
	load_test()
	get_tree().quit()


func load_test() -> void:

	for i in 10:
		ResourceLoader.load("res://test/example_script.gd", "GDScript", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REUSE)

```
* run the scene on Godot4.4.dev4 and Godot4.4.dev5:
output:
```
Loading resource: res://test/test.tscn
Loading resource: res://test/test.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
--- Debugging process stopped ---

```
* run on Godot4.3-dev3
```
Loading resource: res://test/test.tscn
Loading resource: res://test/test.gd
Loading resource: res://test/example_script.gd
--- Debugging process stopped ---
```

comments:
See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/94920 - this brought back the behavior from 4.1 which some users were missing. Those prints hadn't been removed on purpose, so they were added back.

CC @RandomShaper

But I use the flag `CACHE_MODE_REUSE` where indicates the resource should only load if not already cached.
So spamming the load message is not correct in this case.

review_comments:
Will this spam again to the logs?
Why the p_cache_mode is not respected? An already loaded and cached file should not print the loading message again

It may still be somewhat spammy, but not more than it was in the beginning, before I inadvertedly made the change to have the message printed regardless the resource was already cached.

And in that regard we're safe now. If this line is executed, the resource wasn't in cache so it's loaded from disk for sure. The cache mode at this point serves for telling the loader if it has to replace the current cache entry and for dependencies. If a dependency is already loaded, this line won't be reached for it.
